tools.summary: Android framework collection and preprocessing: pull framework files, expand them and pack an analyzable jar (AFE)
tools.notes: releases are published from this repository under tools-v* tags; every tag carries one archive per platform plus afe-SHA256SUMS.txt, so the manager downloads the asset that belongs to the host

tools.summary: APK/DEX analysis on demand: class lookup and reference search (upstream DroidASC, pure Python, no JVM)
tools.notes: DECX creates a private virtualenv and installs the published droidasc package from PyPI; --version pins a PyPI package version

tools.summary: Native decompiler for ELF/PE/Mach-O: functions, pseudo-C, xrefs, disassembly (upstream Kuna)
tools.notes: installed from upstream Noelo-Lab/kuna releases; GitHub asset SHA-256 digests verify both the executable archive and compiled SLEIGH specs, and the launcher exports KUNA_SPECS
